title: Radiant A2UI 1.0 Extension Catalog
description: The A2UI basic catalog plus Radiant form controls, feedback and data display, generated from @cognitap/radiant/catalog.
instructions:
Pick each component by intent; the host theme owns appearance.
- Button runs actions and never navigates. Leave navigation to the host.
- Bind input values to surface state; named actions receive a snapshot of that state.
- Button `variant`: primary only for the main action, default for secondary actions, borderless for low emphasis such as Cancel.
- Tone is the semantic color role (accent, neutral, warning, danger): accent for primary intent, success or confirmation, neutral for information and secondary actions, warning for a problem the user can still avoid, danger for a failure or a destructive action. Tone only sets color; state the meaning in text.
- Control size (small, medium, large) scales controls; keep one size within a group.
- Spacing (tight, normal, airy) is semantic; never request pixel values.

Column.description:
Arranges child elements vertically with semantic spacing and alignment.
Use: Stacking sections, form fields or a card body top to bottom.
Avoid: Side-by-side peers (Row) or data-driven repeats (List).
Examples: form fields followed by a submit Button; heading and paragraph, `align: start`.

Text.description:
Displays formatted text with semantic typographic hierarchy.
Use: Body copy and captions; `variant` picks between them.
Avoid: Status messages or button labels.
Examples: intro paragraph, `variant: body`; note under a form, `variant: caption`.

text.description: Optional dynamic text value read from surface state.

TextField.description:
Collects single-line or multi-line text input with label, description, and validation.
Use: Free text: names, numbers or passwords; `variant: longText` for paragraphs.
Avoid: Known options (ChoicePicker), dates (DateTimeInput) or an approximate number in a range (Slider).
Examples: password, `variant: obscured`; feedback, `variant: longText`.

value.description: Current text value bound to surface state.

variant.description: Input intent controlling native input type or multiline textarea.

CheckBox.description:
Collects an explicit boolean consent or selection state.
Use: An independent yes/no choice submitted later, such as consent.
Avoid: One of several options (ChoicePicker).
Examples: accept the terms; email me product updates.

value.description: Checked state bound to surface state.

ChoicePicker.description:
Selects one or multiple values from curated options using an intent-based presentation.
Use: Known options. `displayStyle: chips` suits tags; `filterable: true` suits long lists.
Avoid: Free text (TextField), a single yes/no (CheckBox) or switching views (Tabs).
Examples: toppings, `variant: multipleSelection`, `displayStyle: chips`; country, `variant: mutuallyExclusive`, `filterable: true`.

variant.description: Whether one or multiple options can be selected.

options.description: Selectable choices presented to the user.

value.description: Selected option value or values bound to surface state.

displayStyle.description: Visual presentation intent for the choice control.

filterable.description: Enables filtering options by typing when presented as a dropdown.

Slider.description:
Selects a numeric value within a bounded range.
Use: An approximate number in a bounded range where relative position matters.
Avoid: Exact values (TextField) or a few discrete options (ChoicePicker).
Examples: volume, `min: 0`, `max: 100`; budget in steps of 100, `min: 500`, `max: 5000`, `steps: 45`.

value.description: Current numeric value bound to surface state.

steps.description: Number of discrete divisions; the renderer derives the canonical step size.

Button.description:
Triggers a client-local update or emits a named outbound action.
Use: An action: submit, save, start, or emit a named `action`.
Avoid: Navigation; Button never renders a link. Picking options (ChoicePicker).
Examples: Save changes, `variant: primary`; Cancel beside it, `variant: borderless`.

child.description: Optional rich content inside the button.

action.description: Action dispatched when the user activates the button.

Icon.description:
Displays a named vector icon from the host icon registry.
Use: A standard icon that adds meaning beside text.
Avoid: Photos or illustrations (Image), or meaning the icon alone must carry.
Examples: warning glyph before a note, `name: warning`; download action, `name: download`, inside a Button.

name.description: A2UI icon name, custom SVG path, or bound icon name.

Image.description:
Displays an image with explicit alternative text and aspect behavior.
Use: Photos, illustrations and avatars. Set `variant` for size intent and `description` for meaning.
Avoid: Standard icons (Icon). Leave `description` empty only for decoration.
Examples: product photo, `variant: mediumFeature`, `fit: cover`; profile picture, `variant: avatar`, `description` naming the person.

url.description: Optional reactive image URL from surface state.

description.description: Alternative text describing the image, or empty string if decorative.

fit.description: How the image fits inside its frame.

Video.description:
Plays a video clip with native browser controls.
Use: A video clip the user starts.
Avoid: Still images (Image), audio only (AudioPlayer) or decorative motion.
Examples: product walkthrough with a `posterUrl` frame; recorded lecture clip.

url.description: Optional reactive video URL from surface state.

AudioPlayer.description:
Plays an audio track with native browser controls.
Use: An audio track such as a podcast or voice note; `description` says what it is.
Avoid: Video (Video) or sounds tied to actions.
Examples: podcast episode with a `description`; pronunciation sample of one word.

url.description: Optional reactive audio URL from surface state.

DateTimeInput.description:
Collects a calendar date, wall-clock time, or combined date and time.
Use: A calendar date, a time, or both; set `enableDate` and `enableTime`.
Avoid: Durations or free text (TextField), or relative picks such as this week (ChoicePicker).
Examples: delivery date, `enableDate: true`, with a `min` bound; meeting start, `enableDate: true`, `enableTime: true`.

value.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time string bound to surface state.

min.description: Minimum allowed ISO 8601 date or time.

max.description: Maximum allowed ISO 8601 date or time.

Row.description:
Arranges child elements horizontally with semantic spacing and alignment.
Use: A few peers side by side: actions, a label and value, or cards.
Avoid: Stacked content (Column) or repeated data (List).
Examples: Cancel and Save buttons, `justify: end`; two Card summaries, `justify: spaceBetween`.

List.description:
Renders a static or data-templated sequence of repeated items.
Use: One template per collection item, or a static run of similar items; templated item state follows index order.
Avoid: One-off layout (Row, Column).
Examples: one Card per search result; image thumbnails, `direction: horizontal`.

children.description: Static item list or templated item prototype bound to collection data.

direction.description: Primary flow direction of list items.

Card.description:
Groups related content and actions inside a bounded surface container.
Use: Several items about one subject side by side, such as projects in a grid.
Avoid: A single section in the page flow or focused tasks (Modal).
Examples: project summary Column inside a Card; plan options as Cards in a Row.

child.description: Primary body content inside the card.

Divider.description:
Separates adjacent sections visually and semantically.
Use: Splitting related content into groups, such as form sections.
Avoid: Adding space, or separating every List item.
Examples: between account and billing sections; between action groups, `axis: vertical`.

axis.description: Axis along which the divider runs.

Tabs.description:
Switches between peer content views in place without leaving the surface.
Use: Peer views where exactly one shows at a time; give each of the `tabs` a `title`.
Avoid: Sections read in sequence, picking a value (ChoicePicker) or navigation.
Examples: Overview, Activity and Settings views; one code sample per language.

tabs.description: Tabs, each pairing a title with the panel component it shows.

Modal.description:
Presents focused secondary content in a native modal dialog.
Use: A focused task or detail that interrupts the page; a Button `trigger` opens it and names it.
Avoid: Messages that stay in the page, confirmations or content that fits inline.
Examples: edit-profile form behind an Edit Button; full terms behind a Read terms Button.

trigger.description: Interactive trigger element that opens the dialog.

content.description: Body content rendered inside the modal dialog.

Select.description:
Single-value dropdown selection backed by Radiant Select.
Use: One value from a long list in a compact dropdown.
Avoid: A few options better seen at once (RadioGroup) or filtering by typing (Combobox).
Examples: country, `items` bound to a data path; time zone with `description` text.

value.description: Stable option value.

items.description: Selectable choices presented to the user.

placeholder.description: Placeholder shown when nothing is chosen.

required.description: Marks the field required; use checks to enforce it.

value.description: Selected option value or values bound to surface state.

Combobox.description:
Filterable dropdown selection backed by Radiant Combobox.
Use: Filtering many options by typing. To search on the host, bind `query`, handle `search`, and update bound `items`, keeping selected ones.
Avoid: Short lists (RadioGroup) or free text (TextField).
Examples: city search, `selection: single`; assignees, `selection: multiple`.

value.description: Stable option value.

items.description: Selectable choices presented to the user.

selection.description: Whether one or multiple options can be selected.

placeholder.description: Placeholder shown when nothing is chosen.

required.description: Marks the field required; use checks to enforce it.

value.description: Selected option value or values bound to surface state.

query.description: Typed search text written to surface state.

search.description: Action sent 250 ms after the typed text changes; with it or query set, items are shown unfiltered.

loading.description: Shows a loading status while the host fetches items.

RadioGroup.description:
Mutually exclusive radio options backed by Radiant RadioGroup.
Use: One value from a few options, all visible at once.
Avoid: Many options (Select) or several values (Combobox).
Examples: delivery speed with a `description` per option; plan size, enforced by checks.

options.description: Selectable choices presented to the user.

value.description: Stable option value.

description.description: Optional supporting detail for the option.

required.description: Marks the field required; use checks to enforce it.

value.description: Selected option value or values bound to surface state.

Switch.description:
Toggles an immediate on or off setting.
Use: A setting that takes effect as soon as it changes.
Avoid: Choices submitted with a form, or consent (CheckBox).
Examples: dark mode; notify me about replies.

checked.description: Current on/off state bound to surface state.

Textarea.description:
Multi-line text input backed by Radiant Textarea.
Use: Paragraphs of free text; set `rows` for the expected length.
Avoid: Single-line values (TextField) or known options (Select).
Examples: feedback, `rows: 4`; bug report, enforced by checks.

rows.description: Visible row count for long text.

required.description: Marks the field required; use checks to enforce it.

value.description: Current text value bound to surface state.

Stage.description:
Frames one interactive widget with a titled header, actions, a body and a footer.
Use: Placing an app widget, such as a map or editor, in its `child` with a `title`; set `aspectRatio` when its size is known.
Avoid: Grouping static content (Card) or focused tasks (Modal).
Examples: map with a zoom Button in `actions`, `aspectRatio: 1.5`; drawing canvas with Undo and Clear in `footer`.

aspectRatio.description: Body width divided by height, held while the body content streams in.

padding.description: Semantic spacing scale owned by Radiant.

child.description: The widget rendered in the body.

Alert.description:
Displays inline status or contextual feedback with optional live announcement.
Use: A message that must stay in the page, with optional follow-up `actions`.
Avoid: Confirming what the user just did (Toast) or an error tied to one field.
Examples: Connection interrupted, `tone: warning`; Payment failed, `tone: danger`, `announce: assertive`.

announce.description: Live-region urgency independent of visual tone.

actions.description: Optional follow-up actions inside the alert.

Badge.description:
Shows compact passive status or category text.
Use: Short passive text labeling a status, count or category.
Avoid: Anything clickable (Button) or updates that must be announced (Alert).
Examples: Needs review, `tone: warning`; 3 new, `tone: accent`.

decorative.description: Hides redundant badges when adjacent text already states the value.

Progress.description:
Shows determinate or indeterminate task completion progress.
Use: A task advancing toward completion; `value: null` when the amount is unknown.
Avoid: Measured levels such as storage, or a static percentage in text.
Examples: upload, `value: 40`, `max: 100`; preparing export, `value: null`.

value.description: Completed amount, or null when progress is indeterminate.

Accordion.description:
Organizes collapsible sections that disclose details on demand.
Use: Sections opened on demand, such as FAQs; each of the `items` names the `panel` it discloses.
Avoid: Switching views where one is always shown (Tabs) or a single short note.
Examples: FAQ with one section open at a time; order details, `selection: multiple`.

selection.description: Whether one or multiple sections may stay open simultaneously.

items.description: Ordered sections, each with a distinct value and the panel it discloses.

value.description: Stable section identifier.

panel.description: Content shown when the section opens.

disabled.description: Prevents expanding or collapsing this section.

value.description: Open section value or values stored in local surface state.

Table.description:
Tabular records with agent-defined columns, backed by Radiant Table. Templated rows are keyed by item index.
Use: Records compared across fields. Each of `rows` is a Row with one child per `columns` entry; a template repeats it per data item, and cells bind item-relative paths.
Avoid: Layout, or items without shared fields (List).
Examples: invoices, `rows` templated over a data path, `align: end` on amount; team members with role and status Badge cells.

density.description: Semantic spacing scale owned by Radiant.

align.description: Logical horizontal alignment for column cells.

rows.description: Row template or explicit row entries rendered per data record.

Toast.description:
Displays a transient notification triggered by an action rather than static layout.
Use: Confirming an action the user just took. Bind `open` to a data path, never a literal; the host sets it true in reply, writing false first to show it again.
Avoid: Messages that must stay (Alert) or decisions before continuing (Modal).
Examples: Draft saved, `open` bound to a data path; Message deleted, `actionLabel: Undo`.

actionLabel.description: Optional label for a single follow-up button inside the toast.

open.description: Data path that shows the toast while true; dismissal writes false.

action.description: Optional outbound action triggered by the toast follow-up button.

required.description: Checks that the value is not null, undefined, or empty.

value.description: The value to check.

regex.description: Checks that the value matches a regular expression string.

pattern.description: The regex pattern to match against.

email.description: Checks that the value is a valid email address.

formatString.description: Performs string interpolation of data model values and other functions in the catalog functions list and returns the resulting string. The value string can contain interpolated expressions in the `${expression}` format. Supported expression types include: JSON Pointer paths to the data model (e.g., `${/absolute/path}` or `${relative/path}`), and renderer-side function calls (e.g., `${now()}`). Function arguments must be named (e.g., `${formatDate(value:${/currentDate}, format:'MM-dd')}`). To include a literal `${` sequence, escape it as `\${`.

formatNumber.description: Formats a number with the specified grouping and decimal precision.

value.description: The number to format.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatCurrency.description: Formats a number as a currency string.

value.description: The monetary amount.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatDate.description: Formats a timestamp into a string using a pattern.

value.description: The date to format.

format.description:
A Unicode TR35 date pattern string.

Token Reference:
- Year: 'yy' (26), 'yyyy' (2026)
- Month: 'M' (1), 'MM' (01), 'MMM' (Jan), 'MMMM' (January)
- Day: 'd' (1), 'dd' (01), 'E' (Tue), 'EEEE' (Tuesday)
- Hour (12h): 'h' (1-12), 'hh' (01-12) - requires 'a' for AM/PM
- Hour (24h): 'H' (0-23), 'HH' (00-23) - Military Time
- Minute: 'mm' (00-59)
- Second: 'ss' (00-59)
- Period: 'a' (AM/PM)

Examples:
- 'MMM dd, yyyy' -> 'Jan 16, 2026'
- 'HH:mm' -> '14:30' (Military)
- 'h:mm a' -> '2:30 PM'
- 'EEEE, d MMMM' -> 'Friday, 16 January'

pluralize.description: Returns a localized string based on the Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR) plural category of the count (zero, one, two, few, many, other). Requires an 'other' fallback. For English, just use 'one' and 'other'.

value.description: The numeric value used to determine the plural category.

two.description: String for the 'two' category (used in Arabic, Welsh, etc.).

few.description: String for the 'few' category (e.g., small groups in Slavic languages).

many.description: String for the 'many' category (e.g., large groups in various languages).

other.description: The default/fallback string (used for general plural cases).

and.description: Performs a logical AND operation on a list of boolean values.

values.description: The list of boolean values to evaluate.

or.description: Performs a logical OR operation on a list of boolean values.

values.description: The list of boolean values to evaluate.

not.description: Performs a logical NOT operation on a boolean value.

value.description: The boolean value to negate.

Weight.description: Relative flex growth of this component inside a Row or Column. Set it only on direct children of a Row or Column.
